build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph for a linear-chain CRF with given features and classes
run_crf_training: run SGD training for a linear-chain CRF model on sampled training data
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding
